inputs.text: Original hand-painted albedo texture for a beautiful stylized 3D fantasy adventure, painterly brushwork with carefully designed large and medium shapes and small accents. An exactly flat orthographic material surface covering the entire square, a continuous repeating surface rather than an object or a scene. Soft diffuse intrinsic material colors, no directional light, no cast shadow, no ambient-occlusion frame, no gradient across the image, no vignette, no border, no text. Seamless on all four edges. Restrained contrast suited to viewing at 128 by 128 pixels; quiet broad areas between clusters, no gritty photographic noise. Old pale limestone cliff surface, large rounded irregular layered stone plates in warm gray, pale sage and muted blue-gray, a few fine softened cracks and small ochre mineral stains. Sparse fern-green moss hugs selected cracks. The stone is weathered by water and wind, elegant broad sculptural shapes rather than a dense tiled brick pattern. Surface only; no boulders standing on ground.
